quests.title: Left Behind
quests.objective: Lü Bu's house, the night Chang'an falls.
quests.objective_zh: 长安城破之夜，吕布府中。

quests.title: Hidden
quests.objective: Take your daughter through the lanes to Pang Shu's house, on the palace lane. When looters come, get into cover and keep still.
quests.objective_zh: 带着女儿穿过小巷，前往宫前巷的庞舒家。乱兵过来时，躲进暗处，不要动。

quests.title: A Guest at Xuzhou
quests.objective: Go to the prefecture hall, on the main street west of the cross, where Liu Bei receives you.
quests.objective_zh: 前往州衙正堂，在十字街口西边的大街上，刘备在那里迎你。

quests.title: Wife and Daughter
quests.objective: Go to your lodging's rear hall, on the north side of the main street east of the cross.
quests.objective_zh: 前往你寓所的后堂，在十字街口东边大街的北侧。

quests.title: Two Tigers
quests.objective: Go to the prefecture hall: Liu Bei has something to show you.
quests.objective_zh: 前往州衙正堂：刘备有东西给你看。

quests.title: The Night Gate
quests.objective: Ride to Xuzhou's west gate in the moonlight.
quests.objective_zh: 趁月色骑到徐州西门。

quests.title: The Halberd at the Camp Gate
quests.objective: Go to your tent in the camp, west of Xiaopei. The halberd stands at the camp gate.
quests.objective_zh: 前往你在小沛西边营中的大帐。画戟插在辕门。

quests.title: A Match for a Princess
quests.objective: Go to Lady Yan's rooms, in the lodging's court.
quests.objective_zh: 前往严氏内室，在寓所院中。

quests.title: The Condolence Call
quests.objective: Go to the prefecture hall: Chen Gui has come to call.
quests.objective_zh: 前往州衙正堂：陈珪来访。

quests.title: Thirty Li
quests.objective: Ride the Shouchun road south after the bridal party, thirty li, and bring the bride home.
quests.objective_zh: 沿寿春路往南追送亲队伍，追出三十里，把新娘带回来。

quests.title: The Hawk
quests.objective: Go to the prefecture hall.
quests.objective_zh: 前往州衙正堂。

quests.title: The Hunt
quests.objective: Take the side path through the hunting ground to the road, and cut the courier off.
quests.objective_zh: 穿过猎场的小路到官道上，截住驿使。

quests.title: The Family Moves
quests.objective: Go to the prefecture hall: Chen Deng has advice for you.
quests.objective_zh: 前往州衙正堂：陈登有话要对你说。

quests.title: Three Letters
quests.objective: Climb the pass road at night and reach the cliff's edge above Cao Cao's camp, unseen by Chen Gong's men.
quests.objective_zh: 趁夜爬上关道，到曹营上方的崖边，别让陈宫的人看见。

quests.title: Locked Out
quests.objective: Ride back to Xuzhou's west gate.
quests.objective_zh: 骑回徐州西门。

quests.title: Chen Gong's Plan
quests.objective: Go to your residence, on the north-west of the city, where Chen Gong waits in your hall.
quests.objective_zh: 前往你的府邸，在城西北，陈宫在你堂上等候。

quests.title: Where Are You Going?
quests.objective: Go from your rooms across the court to his hall, where he is packing to ride out.
quests.objective_zh: 从你的内室穿过院子，到他堂上，他正收拾行装要出城。

quests.title: Through the Lines
quests.objective: Carry your daughter out by the White Gate and down the Huainan road to Liu Bei's lines.
quests.objective_zh: 背着女儿出白门，沿淮南路到刘备的阵线。

quests.title: The Flood
quests.objective: Ride Red Hare round the flooded city, then back to your residence.
quests.objective_zh: 骑赤兔绕行被淹的城池，再回到府中。

quests.title: Fifty Lashes
quests.objective: Go to your residence.
quests.objective_zh: 前往你的府邸。

quests.title: Red Hare
quests.objective: Take Red Hare from the stables and ride out of the dry east gate, unseen.
quests.objective_zh: 从马院牵出赤兔，悄悄从无水的东门骑出城。

quests.title: White Gate Tower
quests.objective: Go up the White Gate tower.
quests.objective_zh: 登上白门楼。
